title: Live MODFLOW6 F-GC34 Bridge Smoke Test

canonical_reconciliation.head: d67a96fd576dcd1c5a30eb766c5aa1a503e10cf0
canonical_reconciliation.delta_since_initial_f_gc36_reconciliatio: 9 commits. Compare 1604b89e... -> d67a96fd... shows only PUB-ME D5 publication workflow, documentation and test files; no F-GC30 through F-GC36 dependency source changed.

qualified_contract: the official MODFLOW6 6.8.0 Linux release archive is downloaded and verified against its published SHA-256 before use
the C-ABI bridge exports fgc34_publish_c and directly invokes the repository's existing publish_modflow6_api_terms implementation
an invalid package-slot mapping returns the real F-GC34 INVALID_BINDING status and leaves NODELIST/HCOF/RHS/NBOUND unchanged
a real xmipy XmiWrapper loads libmf6.so and resolves live MODFLOW6 API-package views
F-GC35 reacquires the API-package view after host prepare_time_step before F-GC34 publication
fresh NumPy view objects may alias the same underlying MODFLOW kernel address; qualification requires refreshed view acquisition and publisher use, not immutability of an older alias
the real F-GC34 bridge publishes NODELIST=2, HCOF=-0.1, RHS=-0.06 and NBOUND=1 into the live API package
the external smoke harness owns prepare_time_step, prepare_solve, solve, finalize_solve and finalize_time_step; production adapters do not
the solved middle-cell head closes to the analytical linear-system solution 1.06/2.1 within the configured tolerance
the live API flux relation HCOF*head-RHS retains the expected positive-infiltration sign

live_pointer_observation.observed: same underlying address before and after refresh in the qualified run
live_pointer_observation.interpretation: xmipy returned a refreshed NumPy view object that aliases the same MODFLOW kernel memory. F-GC35's required semantic is reacquisition and use of the refreshed object, not stale-view memory immutability.

failed_iteration.head: 3b66cd043f93f58a2762ce1b2f310de97e106a1a
failed_iteration.disposition: All official-release download, checksum, bridge-build and real F-GC34 fail-closed checks passed. The live test then rejected a valid XMI alias behavior because it incorrectly required the pre-prepare NumPy view contents to remain immutable. Only the test assertion was corrected; production bridge, F-GC34 and F-GC35 code were unchanged.

qualified: real Fortran F-GC34 execution through C ABI and ctypes
one bounded real MODFLOW6 solve consuming the published linear boundary terms
analytical head and sign closure for the minimal 1x3 smoke model
not_yet_qualified: live SWAP5-generated F-GC30/F-GC31/F-GC33 terms in the same executable run
multi-cell or N:1 live MODFLOW package execution
coupled retry/rollback across SWAP5 and MODFLOW6

next_permitted_action: Independent/admission review of the exact F-GC36 live bridge envelope, or a separately bounded coupled predictor/corrector host workunit that composes existing SWAP transaction services with the now-live MODFLOW package seam. Do not fold Ribasim, irrigation or broader application runtime into F-GC36.
